structural_caveats: 5 SKUs only — small catalog, easy for the classifier to cover exhaustively.

Manufacturing is in China (per company's public statements). Importer-counterfeiters can plausibly source visually similar gloves from same/adjacent factories — silhouette match alone isn't dispositive; combine with name/brand-mark match.
Patent D858,906 covers ornamental design — useful for detecting visual copies but not gloves with a meaningfully different aesthetic that perform similar function.
